nodes.label: Anti-Slop Architectural Invariants
nodes.author: Assify Architecture Council
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Strict prevention of the 20 mobile anti-patterns (no 'everythings a card', no wireframe borders, no floating tab bar collisions).

nodes.label: Component-First Law & Anti-Drift Policy
nodes.author: Assify Architecture Council
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Components import tokens; screens import components. Screens must never invent local container styles or ad-hoc boxes.

nodes.label: Evidence Before Completion (TDD Invariant)
nodes.author: Assify Architecture Council
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Never declare tasks complete without running deterministic test verification and inspecting logs.

nodes.label: Privacy-First Local Sanctuary & Biometric Gate
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.rationale: Conversations and dossiers remain locked behind biometric FaceID/PIN on-device with zero unsolicited cloud transmission.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Mode Local Provider
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.rationale: Provides zero-latency local caching, offline operation, and concurrency protection.

nodes.label: Universal Database Provider Abstraction
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.rationale: Decouple domain business logic from storage engines, allowing local SQLite WAL and Supabase PostgreSQL to be swapped seamlessly.

nodes.label: 0-LLM Neuro-Symbolic Chronemics Engine
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Deterministic mathematical scoring of response latency, initiation ratio, and double-texting avoids LLM hallucinations and costs $0.

nodes.label: Light Apple HIG Design System
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Eliminates visual inconsistency and theme bugs by committing 100% to clean light Apple Human Interface Guidelines.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Teamwork Audit Protocol
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Adversarial review cycles (Author -> Challenger -> Reviewer -> Victory Auditor) to eliminate blindspots and ensure zero shortcuts.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Rigorous engineering methodology converting requirements into invariant specifications, architecture plans, and verifiable task units before code execution.

nodes.label: 9:16 Social Story Card Exporter
nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: 1-tap viral loop mechanism exporting high-res receipt cards directly to Instagram and Snapchat Stories.

nodes.author: Assify Engineering
nodes.community_name: Assify Viral Dopamine Loop & Design Tokens
